description_en: Batch sets key-value pairs in a specified KV namespace based on a specified list of key names. The maximum request body size is 100 MB
description_zh: 根据指定的键名列表来批量设置指定KV存储空间的键值对，请求体最大支持100M
name: BatchPutKvWithHighCapacity

parameters.help_en: The name specified when you called https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850317.html
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en:
A publicly accessible HTTP(S) URL that points to a JSON file containing the key-value pairs to be batch set. The server actively downloads the content from this URL.

If you use an SDK, the SDK automatically uploads the file and generates the URL.

In non-SDK scenarios, upload the JSON payload to any publicly accessible HTTP service and provide the URL.

The file content pointed to by the URL must be in the following JSON format: {"Namespace":"<namespace_name>","KvList":[{"Key":"<key>","Value":"<value>"},...]}.If the URL content does not conform to this format, the API silently returns an empty SuccessKeys array
parameters.help_zh:
包含待批量设置键值对的JSON 文件的公网可访问 HTTP(S) URL，服务端会主动下载该 URL 内容。

如使用SDK，SDK 会自动上传文件并生成 URL。

非SDK 场景请将 JSON payload 上传到任意可公开访问的 HTTP 服务后填入该 URL。

URL 指向的文件内容必须为如下 JSON 格式：{"Namespace":"<命名空间名>","KvList":[{"Key":"<key>","Value":"<value>"},...]}。若 URL 内容格式不符，API 将静默返回空的 SuccessKeys 数组
parameters.name: url

FailKeys.description_en: The list of keys that failed to be written

items.description_en: The key name that failed to be written

SuccessKeys.description_en: The list of keys that were written successfully

items.description_en: The key name that was written successfully
